## Headline

- Claims: **2,725,989** (2,117,326 with a payment, 77.7%), loss years 1978-2026.
- Total paid: **$89.9B nominal = $136.0B in constant 2025 dollars** (building + contents + ICC).
- Severity (paid claims, 2025 $): median $23,809, mean $64,246, p90 $172,036, p99 $461,673.
- Concentration: the top 1% of paid claims carry 11.4% of real paid dollars; top 10% carry 48.0%. The top 5 named events carry 46.8%.
- Building share of building+contents paid: 82.3%; 46.9% of paid claims include a contents payment.
- Outside the SFHA (zones X/B/C/D), 2010-2025: 45.3% of earned policy-years, 25.4% of paid claims, 24.1% of real paid dollars.
- 2010-2025 paid / earned premium (proxy): 0.94; years above 1.0: [2012, 2016, 2017, 2022, 2024].
- Earned exposure 2010-2025: 66.1M policy-years.
- Multiple-loss properties: 240,651 (219,028 NFIP repetitive-loss, 34,996 severe repetitive-loss); 5.5% mitigated, 43.6% currently insured, 76.8% in the SFHA.
